text: This report reviews and recommends approval of the application to amend the Official Plan and Zoning By-law to permit the development of a six storey mixed-use, mid-rise building consisting of 60 dwelling units and 1,140 square metres of non-residential gross floor area at 2026-2040 Queen Street East. The proposed mixed-use building is an appropriate built form and massing that fits with the existing and planned context of the surrounding area. It also meets the intent of the site-specific policies for development along this portion of Queen Street East. The proposed development is consistent with the Provincial Policy Statement (2020) and the Provincial Planning Statement (2024), and conforms with A Place to Grow: Growth Plan for the Greater Golden Horseshoe (2020).
